scope: Separate retrospective objective-proxy reconstruction, never a ladder prediction or validation of subjective wellbeing. Fixed model registered before fetching any numeric objective series for this entry or new 2015-18 health data.

lifeExpectancy.definition: Period life expectancy at birth, total sexes; not healthy life expectancy or a ladder score

sources.observations: World Bank official v2 indicator API, date=1960:1980, source=2, format=json. Reject every row outside these dates before fitting. Save exact bytes, URL, retrieval time, lastupdated, SHA256 and response count.
sources.countryMetadata: World Bank official country API; nonaggregate identifiers determined only by region.id != NA. Current identifiers and country definitions are not an archived 1980 roster.
sources.indicatorMetadata: World Bank official indicator API, source=2; metadata only. No unrestricted observation downloads.

cohort.rule: All nonaggregate official country IDs with both valid outcomes in 1980 and at least 10 nonmissing observations spanning at least 10 years within 1960-1980 for EACH target. GDP must be finite and positive; life expectancy finite and strictly between 0 and 120. Freeze using training/origin only; no future availability conditions.
cohort.denominator: Save every metadata ID, aggregate exclusion, country exclusion reason, per-target training count/span, and final IDs in cohort.json. Both targets share this frozen country cohort.

fit.selection: None. One fixed method; no model/hyperparameter tuning or internal-validation-driven amendments.
equations: For each target and country, transform GDP with natural log and leave life expectancy in years.
Fit ordinary least squares z_t = a + b*(t-1960), separately by country/target using every valid 1960-1980 observation. Equal annual weights; missing observations omitted only from fit; no imputation.
Let S(h)=sum(k=1..h,0.95^k)=0.95*(1-0.95^h)/(1-0.95). Forecast z_(1980+h)=z_1980+b*S(h). The fitted intercept is diagnostic; the observed 1980 origin anchors the forecast.
GDP forecast = exp(z_forecast). Life-expectancy forecast = clamp(z_forecast,0,120) with raw forecast and clamp counts saved. No trend clipping.
fit.fittedQuantities: OLS slope/intercept, training observation count, span and origin value per country/target; no pooled normalization, imputation or learned damping.
fit.futureCovariates: None. Only pre-1981 target histories and 1980 origins.

internalValidation.purpose: Diagnostic only, never model selection; temporally ordered pre-1981 validation.
internalValidation.rule: Within the frozen final cohort, require valid 1975 origin and at least 10 training observations spanning 10 years for a target. Fit its slope only through 1975; forecast each observed 1976-80 target using the same fixed equation. Report skipped origins and outcome masks. No normalization; no validation values enter fits.

missingness: Never delete a frozen country because future targets are missing. Score each target/year only where valid observed; save missingness and identical persistence masks. No backward filling, interpolation or invented observations by this model.

predictionSchema.rows: One row per country/year/target with id,name,target,unit,year,horizon,originYear,originValue,prediction,rawPrediction; targets exactly lifeExpectancy or gdp; 45*2*N rows

baseline: Persistence of each target's observed 1980 value on exactly the same scoring masks
primaryMetric: 2025 endpoint MAE separately for life expectancy (years) and GDP cumulative growth error (percentage points relative to 1980 GDP); two outcomes, no combined winner
secondaryMetrics: Every annual horizon MAE, RMSE, signed bias and denominator
Pooled observed country-year MAE/RMSE/bias per target
GDP level MAE in constant-2015 USD as supplementary
exposureDisclosure: The agent has read the authorized 2015-18 original ladder/GDP train/origin schema and a few leading rows while preparing the separate short-horizon entry. No long-run model choice uses those values. This long-run protocol is registered before fetching new health series, and long-run forecasts will be frozen before developing the health extension. Current source-method pages are allowed; no post-1980 country trajectory is sought for long-run development.
vintageLimit: Historical values retrieved in 2026 are revised/current-vintage data, not information archived as available in 1980. Publication lag, modeled/interpolated life tables, changed borders and survivorship of current country identifiers limit interpretation. Fixed damping is an assumption, not a fitted historical law.
integrityGates: Read only date-scoped 1960-80 training responses and source metadata
Freeze full forecasts/cohort/code/provenance before the controller's single external score
All five short entries and this long entry must be frozen before any external scoring
Publish failure as well as success; no post-score refit
No ladder mapping, wellbeing causality or 1980 real-time forecast claim
